description: Sydney Harbour Bathymetry 1997 (2376/19970009S) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. The Sydney Harbour Area Survey was conducted by Sydney University aboard the Motor Vessel (M/V) Hydrographer between 18 and 27 November 1997. Data were acquired using an Atlas Fansweep 20 (200 kHz) multibeam echosounder. Not to be used for navigational purposes. Coverage: Sydney Harbour. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are AusSeabed, Australia-wide geoscience data, Bathymetry, Coral Sea, EARTH SCIENCES. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
